__comment__: Maps Snap Shot AppFolio display name -> TICAM ClickUp dropdown option (list 901112111796, field 'Property (A/O)'). Only properties whose Snap Shot name doesn't already match a TICAM dropdown option verbatim are listed here — everything else falls back to exact name match. Entries with an array of two names are properties where TICAM has duplicate dropdown rows (see South Memorial); the fetcher will pick the first non-empty 2026 row, preferring 'confirmed' status.
